entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the arrival date.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Chad, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Everyone except citizens of a list of mostly Central and West African countries needs a visa.
entry.es: Todos necesitan visa, salvo los ciudadanos de una lista de países mayormente de África central y occidental.
entry.quote: Everyone, except citizens of Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ivory Coast, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania, Niger and Senegal, needs a visa to enter the country.

entry.en: Anyone staying in Chad more than 72 hours must register with the police.
entry.es: Quien permanezca en Chad más de 72 horas debe registrarse ante la policía.
entry.quote: If you stay in Chad more than 72 hours, you must register with the police.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se viene de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Chad, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: A 'tourist tax' of 5,000 CFA per person per site applies.
entry.es: Se cobra una 'tasa turística' de 5.000 CFA por persona y por sitio.
entry.quote: There is a 'tourist tax' of 5,000 CFA per person per site

entry.en: An e-visa is in theory available from December 2024.
entry.es: En teoría hay visa electrónica disponible desde diciembre de 2024.
entry.quote: An e-visa is in theory available from December 2024.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to the rest of Chad, including N'Djamena.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje no esencial al resto de Chad, incluida N'Djamena.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to the rest of Chad, including the capital, N’Djamena.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to the Lake Chad region because of a high risk of terrorist kidnapping.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a la región del lago Chad por el alto riesgo de secuestro terrorista.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the Lake Chad region. There is a high risk of terrorist kidnapping in the Lake Chad region.

safety.en: There are many landmines near the Chad-Libya border in the northern provinces.
safety.es: Hay muchas minas terrestres cerca de la frontera entre Chad y Libia en las provincias del norte.
safety.quote: There are many landmines near the Chad-Libya border in these provinces.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 30km of Chad's other borders.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 30 km de las demás fronteras de Chad.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to within 30km of all of Chad’s other borders.

safety.en: There is a high risk of carjacking on roads outside N'Djamena, including during the daytime.
safety.es: Hay un alto riesgo de robo de vehículos a mano armada en las rutas fuera de N'Djamena, también de día.
safety.quote: There is a high risk of carjacking on roads outside N’Djamena, including during the daytime.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Chad.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten perpetrar atentados en Chad.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Chad.

health.en: Medical facilities in Chad are poor, and even N'Djamena hospitals are stretched and sometimes hit by strikes.
health.es: Los servicios médicos en Chad son deficientes y hasta los hospitales de N'Djamena están sobrecargados y a veces afectados por huelgas.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Chad are poor. Even in N’Djamena hospitals are stretched and sometimes affected by strikes.

health.en: Drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: Bebe o usa solo agua hervida o embotellada y evita el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: You should drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Chad is described as officially having the worst tap water quality in the world.
health.es: Se describe a Chad como el país con la peor calidad de agua de la llave del mundo, oficialmente.
health.quote: Officially, Chad has the worst tap water quality in the world.

health.en: Malaria is described as the country's deadliest disease.
health.es: Se describe la malaria como la enfermedad más mortal del país.
health.quote: Malaria is the country's deadliest disease.

health.en: Chad lies in the African Meningitis Belt.
health.es: Chad se encuentra en el cinturón africano de la meningitis.
health.quote: The country is in the African Meningitis Belt.

health.en: Proof of yellow fever and Covid vaccinations is described as mandatory to enter.
health.es: Se indica que es obligatorio presentar comprobante de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla y el Covid para entrar.
health.quote: Proof of Yellow fever and Covid vaccinations are mandatory to enter the country.

help.en: The emergency numbers are 1212 for ambulance and fire and 2020 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 1212 (ambulancia y bomberos) y 2020 (policía).

help.en: Call 1212 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: Llama al 1212 y pide una ambulancia.
help.quote: Call 1212 and ask for an ambulance.

getting_in.en: Air France has daily flights from Paris to N'Djaména.
getting_in.es: Air France tiene vuelos diarios de París a N'Djaména.
getting_in.quote: Air France has daily flights from Paris to N'Djaména.

getting_in.en: There are no usable rail links.
getting_in.quote: There are no usable rail links.

getting_in.en: There are several border crossings with Cameroon, most notably via Kousseri near N'Djamena and near Bongor and Lere.
getting_in.es: Hay varios pasos fronterizos con Camerún, sobre todo por Kousseri cerca de N'Djamena y cerca de Bongor y Lere.
getting_in.quote: There are several border crossings with Cameroon, most notably via Kousseri near N'Djamena and near the towns of Bongor and Lere.

getting_in.en: The Chad-Sudan border is closed to travellers, with limited humanitarian exceptions.
getting_in.es: La frontera entre Chad y Sudán está cerrada a los viajeros, con excepciones humanitarias limitadas.
getting_in.quote: The Chad-Sudan border is closed to travellers, with limited humanitarian exceptions.

getting_in.en: Roads are in disrepair and are typically unpaved.
getting_in.es: Los caminos están en mal estado y suelen ser de tierra.
getting_in.quote: Roads are in disrepair and are typically unpaved.

getting_in.en: Driving at night is discouraged because road bandits ('coupeurs de route') are common.
getting_in.es: Se desaconseja conducir de noche porque son comunes los bandoleros de caminos ('coupeurs de route').
getting_in.quote: Do not drive at night, as coupeurs de route (road bandits) are common.

getting_around.en: N'Djamena has both vehicle taxis and motorcycle taxis.
getting_around.es: N'Djamena tiene taxis de vehículo y mototaxis.
getting_around.quote: In N'Djamena there are both vehicle taxis and motorcycle taxis.

getting_around.en: In some major towns such as Moundou and Sarh there might be only motorcycle taxis or, further east, rickshaws.
getting_around.es: En algunas ciudades grandes como Moundou y Sarh puede haber solo mototaxis o, más al este, rickshaws.
getting_around.quote: In some major towns, such as Moundou and Sarh, there might be only "clandos" - motorcycle taxis - or rickshaws (more towards the east of the country) for getting around town.

getting_around.en: Any substantial visit will be by an organised tour because most of the country is inaccessible.
getting_around.es: Cualquier visita sustancial será con un tour organizado porque la mayor parte del país es inaccesible.
getting_around.quote: Due to the inaccessibility of most of the country, any substantial visit will be by an organised tour.

getting_around.en: The N'Djamena-Abeche road is a toll road with a fixed 500 CFA per car at toll stations every 80km.
getting_around.es: La ruta N'Djamena-Abeche es de peaje, con 500 CFA fijos por auto en casetas cada 80 km.
getting_around.quote: The road between N'Djamena and Abeche is a toll road, with toll stations every 80km where a fixed rate of 500 CFA per car has to be paid.

getting_around.en: Charter flights exist to Zakouma NP and Faya-Largeau Airport and are used by more upmarket tours.
getting_around.es: Hay vuelos chárter al PN Zakouma y al aeropuerto de Faya-Largeau, usados por tours de gama alta.
getting_around.quote: Charter flights exist to Zakouma NP and Faya-Largeau Airport (for Ennedi), and are used by the more upmarket tours around Chad.

money.en: The currency is the Central African CFA franc (FCFA, code XAF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Central (FCFA, código XAF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Central African CFA franc, denoted FCFA (ISO currency code: XAF).

money.en: There are no restrictions on bringing foreign currency, and euros and US dollars are often accepted.
money.es: No hay restricciones para ingresar divisas, y a menudo se aceptan euros y dólares estadounidenses.
money.quote: There are no restrictions on bringing foreign currencies into Chad. Euros and US dollars are often accepted in payment.

money.en: Ecobank ATMs let you withdraw cash with a Mastercard or Visa card.
money.es: En los cajeros de Ecobank se puede retirar efectivo con Mastercard o Visa.
money.quote: There are Ecobank ATMs in Chad where you can withdraw cash with a Mastercard or Visa card.

money.en: Chad is expensive compared to much of Africa, especially for accommodation and transport.
money.es: Chad es caro comparado con gran parte de África, sobre todo en alojamiento y transporte.
money.quote: Chad is an expensive place compared to much of Africa, especially regarding accommodation and transport.

money.en: Outside expat areas a soft drink costs between 300 and 500 CFA.
money.es: Fuera de las zonas frecuentadas por expatriados, un refresco cuesta entre 300 y 500 CFA.
money.quote: Outside of the places frequented by expats, a soft drink will cost between 300 and 500 CFA.

money.en: Both CFA currencies are fixed at €1 = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: Ambas monedas CFA tienen un tipo fijo de 1 € = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of €1 = 655.957 CFA francs.

etiquette.en: People are reluctant to be photographed, so always ask first.
etiquette.es: La gente es reacia a ser fotografiada, así que siempre hay que pedir permiso.
etiquette.quote: As in other Sahel countries, natives are reluctant to be photographed, so always ask.

etiquette.en: There is a general ban on photographing anything of military or governmental importance.
etiquette.es: Hay una prohibición general de fotografiar todo lo de importancia militar o gubernamental.
etiquette.quote: Also there is a general ban on photography for anything that might be of any military or governmental importance.

etiquette.en: Muslims find eating with the left hand offensive, so use only your right hand.
etiquette.es: A los musulmanes les ofende comer con la mano izquierda, así que usa solo la derecha.
etiquette.quote: Muslims find it offensive to eat with the left hand. If eating with or being served by Muslims in Chad, eat with your right hand only.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan most restaurants in the north and center are closed and public eating and drinking is not accepted.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán la mayoría de los restaurantes del norte y centro cierran y no se acepta comer ni beber en público.
etiquette.quote: During Ramadan most restaurants in the northern and central parts of Chad are closed and eating and drinking in public is not accepted.

etiquette.en: The Chadian-Libyan conflict should not be discussed, as Chadians living in Libya have been tortured and murdered.
etiquette.es: No se debe hablar del conflicto entre Chad y Libia, pues chadianos que viven en Libia han sido torturados y asesinados.
etiquette.quote: Do not discuss the Chadian-Libyan conflict; Chadians living in Libya have been tortured and murdered.

etiquette.en: Alcohol is sometimes difficult and not well regarded outside cities in the Muslim north and center, but no problem in the south and N'Djamena.
etiquette.es: El alcohol es a veces difícil de conseguir y mal visto fuera de las ciudades en el norte y centro musulmanes, pero no hay problema en el sur y N'Djamena.
etiquette.quote: It is therefore sometimes difficult (and not well regarded) to find and consume alcohol outside of the cities. It's no problem in the south and in N'Djamena.

connectivity.en: Airtel and Moov SIM cards can be bought almost everywhere on the streets.
connectivity.es: Las SIM de Airtel y Moov se compran casi en cualquier calle.
connectivity.quote: You can buy SIM cards of one of the bigger telecommunication enterprises (Airtel & Moov) almost everywhere on the streets.

connectivity.en: 3G/4G coverage is limited to N'Djamena and a few other large towns.
connectivity.es: La cobertura 3G/4G se limita a N'Djamena y unas pocas ciudades grandes.
connectivity.quote: 3G/4G coverage is limited to N'Djamena and a few other large towns.

connectivity.en: A number of eSIM providers have products for Chad.
connectivity.es: Varios proveedores de eSIM tienen productos para Chad.
connectivity.quote: A number of eSIM providers have products for Chad.

connectivity.en: Few places offer stable Wifi connections.
connectivity.es: Hay pocos lugares con conexiones wifi estables.
connectivity.quote: since there is not many places that offer stable Wifi connections.

connectivity.en: Facebook, Twitter and WhatsApp have been intermittently blocked since March 2018 and are then only accessible via VPN.
connectivity.es: Facebook, Twitter y WhatsApp están bloqueados de forma intermitente desde marzo de 2018 y entonces solo se acceden con VPN.
connectivity.quote: Social media sites including Facebook, Twitter, and WhatsApp have been intermittently blocked since March 2018 and then are only accessible via VPN.
